project_name: ISA Feature Computation and MATILDA Pipeline for Static H-ODBRP
context: Implement a reliable static H-ODBRP feature pipeline and MATILDA-ready outputs before the supervisor review on 2026-05-30. Decisions are now fixed from answered open questions: stops/travel-time data come from CSV files, coordinates are lon/lat, OD distance should use driving distance, walking threshold should default to 10 minutes (configurable), and MATILDA should use Python. service_area_km2 should be derived from reachable geometry when available by converting reachable nodes/edges into a polygon and measuring area in km2, with bounding-box fallback only as a documented last resort. Scope includes features #1-#21, while #22-#23 stay deferred.

tasks.name: Lock assumptions from answered OQs
tasks.context: Write a compact assumptions block in code comments and implementation notes using the confirmed answers: CSV sources for stops/ttm, lon-lat coordinates, driving-distance policy for OD metrics, Python MATILDA path, and configurable walking threshold defaulting to 10 minutes. For service_area_km2, derive area from reachable geometry by converting nodes/edges into a polygon and calculating km2, with bounding-box fallback only if geometry is unavailable. Done means no unresolved assumptions remain for coding tasks.

tasks.name: Create feature-engineering scaffold
tasks.context: Create compute_features(instance: dict) with the exact 21-key flat numeric contract. Add shared helper functions for safe stats, NaN-safe returns, and data validation. Done means smoke-call on a minimal instance returns all required keys with numeric values or NaN where appropriate.

tasks.name: Implement CSV loaders for stops and ttm
tasks.context: Implement reusable loaders that read stop metadata and travel-time matrices from REQreate CSV outputs. Keep interfaces simple so downstream feature functions can request stop coordinates, station degrees, and node-to-node driving times. Done means loaders work on Maastricht files and return validated structures.

tasks.name: Implement demand-size features 1-3
tasks.context: Implement n_requests, demand_density, and spatial_cluster_coeff. Include fallback when service_area_km2 is missing or ambiguous, and document the fallback in logs/notes. Done means the three features compute deterministically on sample instances.

tasks.name: Implement OD driving-distance features 4-5
tasks.context: Implement od_distance_mean and od_distance_std using driving distances from matrix/network data as primary method. If unavailable, apply explicit fallback and warning behavior. Done means outputs use driving distance by default and pass quick sanity checks.

tasks.name: Implement time-window features 6-9
tasks.context: Implement tw_width_mean, tw_width_std, tw_overlap_ratio, and tight_tw_fraction with robust handling for empty or malformed request sets. Done means all four metrics compute correctly on unit-like toy data and real sample files.

tasks.name: Implement tw_tightness_factor feature 10
tasks.context: Implement tw_tightness_factor using request-specific minimum trip time from driving travel-time data. Add fallback policy only when driving times are missing, and skip invalid rows safely. Done means metric matches definition and produces stable values across sampled instances.

tasks.name: Implement fleet features 11-14
tasks.context: Implement fleet_size, capacity_cv, fleet_utilization_ratio, and request_vehicle_ratio. Handle zero-division and empty fleet/request edge cases explicitly. Done means outputs are numeric and interpretable under normal and degenerate cases.

tasks.name: Implement stop/network features 15-17
tasks.context: Implement station_density, bsa_flexibility, and avg_station_degree using CSV stop data. For walking-based calculations, convert 10-minute default into distance using walk-speed input when present, with a documented default speed fallback. Done means outputs are consistent and bsa_flexibility edge interpretation is noted.

tasks.name: Implement coverage_ratio feature 18
tasks.context: Implement grid-based coverage_ratio with configurable grid density and walking threshold derived from the 10-minute rule. Add a performance guard so runtime remains practical. Done means output is stable and documented with grid/threshold parameters.

tasks.name: Implement static dynamic placeholders 19-21
tasks.context: Implement request_flux_dynamism, static_to_dynamic_ratio, and avg_request_urgency for static runs with predictable constant/near-constant behavior. Keep functions future-proof for dynamic variants. Done means all three features are always present and numeric.

tasks.name: Integrate generation-time features.csv export
tasks.context: Wire compute_features into generation flow so each produced instance appends one row to data/results/features.csv with instance stem as key. Add schema enforcement and duplicate-key protection. Done means repeated generation produces clean, aligned CSV rows.

tasks.name: Build perf_matrix normalization export
tasks.context: Generate data/results/perf_matrix.csv with SA, IP, GR normalized to [0,1] and strict index alignment to features.csv. Add assertion checks and clear error messages for mismatch. Done means file passes range and alignment checks.

tasks.name: Run MATILDA preprocessing and fit
tasks.context: Implement/update src/isa_pipeline.py to preprocess features (drop constant, handle NaN, remove static dynamic columns), fit InstanceSpace in Python, and export instance_space.csv plus footprint figures. Done means script runs end-to-end on current dataset.

tasks.name: QA pass and supervisor-ready summary
tasks.context: Run smoke tests and a short batch validation, then prepare a concise review summary covering implemented features, deferred scope (#22-#23), assumption decisions, known caveats, and next steps. Done means outputs are reproducible and ready to discuss in the May 30 supervisor review.
